name: Zylo
description:
Zylo is the leading enterprise SaaS Management Platform, giving IT, Finance, and Procurement teams complete visibility and control over their organization's software portfolio — directly from Claude.

With the Zylo connector, you can ask Claude to surface insights from your SaaS data without leaving your workflow. Query your application inventory, review spend and utilization trends, manage contracts and renewal timelines, track license allocation, and identify cost-saving opportunities — all through natural language.

What you can do:
• Query and analyze your SaaS portfolio — spend, utilization, license data, and application stats — using natural language
• Manage applications, contracts, and contract line items, including uploading PDF contracts for AI-powered data extraction
• Set and update budgets, savings events, and spend alerts to track financial performance and flag risks
• Run pre-built analysis playbooks for common workflows like renewal reviews, license optimization, and spend analysis
• Manage views, custom fields, and Zylo users to keep your platform organized and access-controlled

Zylo's connector is ideal for IT leaders, SAM teams, Procurement, and FinOps professionals who want to act on SaaS intelligence faster — without switching context.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Zylo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Zylo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.zylo.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Zylo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zylo lists 28 MCP tools, including alert_create, alert_update, application_budget_create, application_budget_update, application_create, application_update, contract_create, contract_document_upload, contract_line_item_create, contract_line_item_update, contract_update, and custom_field_create.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Zylo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Zylo in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Zylo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Zylo is developed by Zylo. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
